project.title: Bundar Delivery
project.description: Dependency-aware delivery board for Bundar's 96 stable-ID issues.

fields.name: Stable ID
fields.purpose: Portable GH-NNN identity independent of GitHub issue numbers.

fields.name: Status
fields.note: GitHub's native project status field currently exposes Todo/In Progress/Done; review state is represented by pull-request linkage and the committed PR template.

fields.name: Depends On
fields.purpose: Stable IDs only; never GitHub numbers.

fields.name: Evidence Link
fields.purpose: Path or URL to recorded verification evidence.

automation.mergeBehavior: Never auto-close as Done without acceptance evidence
automation.dependencyBehavior: Dependency completion does not automatically mark an issue Ready
